name: podcast-shorts
description: Podcast to shorts: transcribe, an agent picks the strongest quotes and makes vertical word-captioned shorts, exported for Shorts

agent.brief: This is a long podcast recording ({name}). Pick the 3 strongest self-contained moments, 20 to 60 seconds each, each with a clear hook in its first 3 seconds. Make each its own vertical 1080x1920 sequence named short-1, short-2, short-3, keeping the speaker in frame. Add word captions to each (transcript.createCaptions, then bashcut.captions.wordStyle with style.preset pop). Export each with bashcut.profiles.apply {profile: shorts, path: {outputs}/{name}-short-N.mp4, wait: true}. Save the project.
